input: The first suspend attempt after boot fails with 'spm: SPM firmware handshake timeout'. The SPM firmware is loaded by the kernel driver from the firmware partition. Subsequent suspend attempts succeed. This only happens on the very first suspend after a cold boot. Note: SPM (System Power Manager) is a MediaTek-specific subsystem; refer to your custom/ TRM for register details. How do I debug a one-shot SPM handshake failure on first suspend?
